message: Field "FieldKey.id" has type Unsupported(...), so the Prisma 8 model has no field for it, but its @id uses it, and without it model "FieldKey" has no field that identifies a row, so Prisma 8 could not update, delete or relate its rows. Add @@ignore on model "FieldKey": Prisma 7 then requires @ignore on every relation field that points to the model, its next migration is empty, Prisma 8 keeps the model's table with its primary key, and the model disappears from both clients.
